chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Athens, 2004: the Olympic final, Argentina against Paraguay. Fabricio Coloccini breaks out of defence. The winger races down the right and crosses to the near post. Carlos Tevez gets there first... Goal!

chapters.label: Watch Tevez
chapters.text: Watch Tevez. He never stops moving. He runs between two defenders, toward the near post, just as the cross comes in.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: From six yards, he prods it in! His eighth goal of the Olympics, and Argentina win the gold!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep moving in the box, so you are ready the moment the chance arrives!
